name: cryoshield-vault-v1
encoding: All byte strings are lowercase hex. Integers are JSON numbers.

vaults.name: any-of-2
vaults.secretUtf8: abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon abandon art

vaults.name: any-of-3
vaults.description: Mode 0x01, keys A+B+C (C has a 48-byte credential ID).

vaults.name: any-of-2-max
vaults.description: Mode 0x01, keys A+B, secret of exactly maxPayloadBytes (638); padding granularity makes the blob 974 bytes.

decodeCases.name: truncated-last-byte
decodeCases.description: Blob with the final byte removed.

decodeCases.name: truncated-header
decodeCases.description: Blob cut to its first 20 bytes.

decodeCases.name: oversize-blob
decodeCases.description: The max vault with one extra 64-byte payload block (1038 bytes > 1024).

decodeCases.name: duplicate-cred-id
decodeCases.description: Entry B's credential ID replaced by entry A's.

openCases.name: unknown-cred-id
openCases.description: Key A's PRF but key D's credential ID.

openCases.name: tampered-header-rpid
openCases.description: One rpId byte flipped (inside every wrap AAD).

openCases.name: tampered-wrapped-key-own
openCases.description: Entry A's wrapped key flipped, opened with A.

openCases.name: tampered-wrapped-key-other
openCases.description: Entry A's wrapped key flipped, opened with B (payload AAD covers entry A).

openCases.name: swapped-entries
openCases.description: Entries A and B swapped (wrap AAD binds the entry index).

openCases.name: tampered-payload-ct
openCases.description: Last tag byte of the payload flipped.

openCases.name: shamir-C-A
openCases.description: 2-of-3 with keys C and A (given in reverse order).

addKeyCases.name: add-C-with-A
addKeyCases.description: Add key C to any-of-2 using only key A.

addKeyCases.name: add-C-with-wrong-key
addKeyCases.description: Add key C using unenrolled key D.

addKeyCases.name: add-duplicate
addKeyCases.description: Add key B again using key A.

addKeyCases.name: add-to-shamir
addKeyCases.description: Add key D to the 2-of-3 Shamir vault.

addKeyCases.name: add-oversize
addKeyCases.description: Add key C to the 1024-byte max vault.

addKeyCases.name: add-ninth-key
addKeyCases.description: Add a 9th key to an 8-key vault.

updatePayloadCases.name: update-with-B
updatePayloadCases.description: Key B replaces the any-of-2 secret.

updatePayloadCases.name: update-wrong-key
updatePayloadCases.description: Unenrolled key D tries to update.

updatePayloadCases.name: update-shamir-A-C
updatePayloadCases.description: Keys A and C update the 2-of-3 secret.

selectCases.name: squatted-locator
selectCases.description: Genuine any-of-2 blob after three junk blobs, followed by the genuine any-of-3 blob.

selectCases.name: no-genuine-candidate
selectCases.description: Only junk blobs under the locator.

authenticatorDataCases.name: uv-set
authenticatorDataCases.description: Flags UP|UV (0x05): PRF output may be used.

authenticatorDataCases.name: truncated
authenticatorDataCases.description: 36 bytes: too short to hold flags and signCount.
